# REX Bunny Services
> Marketing Agency for SEO, GEO & AEO — Making your brand visible in every search.

## About
REX Bunny Services is a marketing agency specializing in SEO (Search Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization). We make brands visible in Google, ChatGPT, Gemini, Siri, Alexa, Perplexity, and Copilot.

## Services
- [SEO (Traditional & Local Search)](https://rexbunnyservices.online/services/seo): Technical SEO, local SEO, programmatic multi-location optimization
- [GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)](https://rexbunnyservices.online/services/ai-search-optimization): Entity engineering, LLM citation optimization, AI crawl strategy
- [AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)](https://rexbunnyservices.online/services/aeo): Featured snippets, voice search, AI Overviews, direct answer engineering
- [Web Development](https://rexbunnyservices.online/services/web-development): High-performance websites, Lighthouse 95+ guaranteed, sub-second load times

## FAQ
- **What is GEO?** Generative Engine Optimization is the practice of engineering websites to be cited in AI search responses from ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Copilot.
- **What is AEO?** Answer Engine Optimization is the practice of engineering content to become the direct answer in AI Overviews, featured snippets, voice search, and assistants like Siri and Alexa.
- **How is GEO different from SEO?** SEO optimizes for Google rankings. GEO optimizes for AI model citation. AEO optimizes for direct answers.
- **How long does GEO take?** Initial AI citations within 4-8 weeks, full authority in 3-6 months.
